==Description== <!--T:10-->

<!--T:2-->
Renders the selected raytracing project using an external renderer.

==Usage== <!--T:11-->

<!--T:3-->
# Select raytracing project in the [[Tree_view|tree view]].
# Click on [[Image:Raytracing_Render.svg|32px]] or choose {{KEY| Raytracing}}  →  {{KEY|[[Image:Raytracing_Render.svg|32px]] Render}} from the top menu.

==Limitations== <!--T:12-->

<!--T:4-->
Currently only POV-Ray and Luxrender are supported.
